newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Mayban Property Trust listing put off.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Mayban Property Trust listing put off.

text.p: Mayban Property Trust Management Bhd said that the proposed listing of Mayban Property Trust Fund One on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange has been deferred due to a technical problem.

In a statement sent to the exchange late on Thursday, Mayban Property said the Malaysian Central Depository has not been able to credit the units into the respective unitholders' Central Depository System (CDS) accounts due to "incompatability of data". It did not elaborate.

Malaysian stocks have been transferred to the CDS, an electronic trading and settlement system, which does away with physical clearing of trades. The new system is expected to allow brokers to offer more efficient service.
